body:
# Practical Additions

**Organize your gear. Light up the depths. Get practical.**

🛠️ Practical Additions v1.0.1 – Summary

Visual & Model 
- Split model: solid opaque frame + emissive lens (no transparency bugs).
- Emissive neon glow using “eyes” render type (visible in darkness).
- State textures: Active (bright neon), Inactive (dark lens).
- Auto-OFF when placed on a Helmet Stand.  
   
Items & Compatibility
- Durability bar fixed.
- Mining Helmet defaults to Tier 1 (600 capacity).
- Helmets/batteries craft fully charged.
- Loot tables fixed (blocks drop correctly).
- Replaced copper_ingot with gold_ingot (1.16.5 JEI fix).
- Added final recipes for Charging Station & Mining Helmet.

Practical Additions is a Minecraft Forge mod for **1.16.5** that adds functional storage displays, a battery-powered **Mining Helmet** with a dynamic headlamp, and a rechargeable battery system — all designed to fit naturally into the vanilla Minecraft experience.

---

## 🎮 Controls

| Action | Input | Result |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Place item on rack** | Right-click rack with valid tool/weapon | Places item in first empty slot |
| **Take item from rack** | Right-click rack with empty hand | Removes clicked item |
| **Rotate rack item** | Sneak + Right-click (empty hand) | Rotates displayed item |
| **Place helmet on stand** | Right-click stand with head armor | Places helmet |
| **Take helmet from stand** | Right-click stand (empty hand) | Removes helmet |
| **Swap helmet** | Right-click stand with different helmet | Swaps helmets |
| **Install battery (in hand)** | Sneak + Right-click (helmet main + battery offhand) | Inserts battery |
| **Remove battery** | Sneak + Right-click (helmet main hand + empty offhand) | Removes battery |
| **Install battery (wearing)** | Right-click while holding battery | Installs battery |
| **Toggle headlamp** | `L` key (rebindable) | Toggles light on/off |
| **Insert battery into charger** | Right-click Charging Station with battery | Starts charging |
| **Remove battery from charger** | Right-click Charging Station (empty hand) | Removes battery |

---

## ⚔️ Weapon & Tool Racks

Display your weapons, tools, and gear using wall-mounted or freestanding racks.

### Wall Racks
*   Attach to any solid vertical surface.
*   Hold **2 items**.
*   Visually connect when placed side by side.
*   **Variants:** Wooden Wall Rack, Metal Wall Rack.

### Floor Racks
*   Freestanding design.
*   Hold **2 vertically displayed items**.
*   Automatically connect into multi-rack variants.
*   **Variants:** Wooden Floor Rack, Metal Floor Rack.

### Features
*   ✅ **Simple Interaction:** Right-click to place; Right-click with an empty hand to remove.
*   ✅ **Rotation:** Sneak + Right-click to rotate items.
*   ✅ **Precision:** Slot selection based on where you click.
*   ✅ **Compatibility:** Accepts swords, axes, pickaxes, shovels, hoes, tridents, bows, crossbows, and all tiered tools.

---

## ⛑️ Mining Helmet

A wearable iron-tier helmet with a built-in **dynamic headlamp**.

The light follows your exact look direction, including vertical movement. When the battery runs out, the light turns off automatically.

### How It Works
1. **Craft** the Mining Helmet.
2. **Equip** it in your head slot.
3. **Insert** a battery.
4. The headlamp activates automatically.
5. Battery drains over time while the light is on.

### Features
*   🔦 **Directional dynamic lighting** (follows your gaze).
*   🔋 **5 battery tiers** with different durations.
*   📊 **HUD battery indicator** with color levels and low-charge warnings.
*   🔑 **Toggleable light** via keybind.
*   🛡️ **Iron-tier protection** (2 armor points).
*   🎒 **Optional Curios API** support.

---

## 🔋 Batteries (5 Tiers)

Rechargeable batteries power the Mining Helmet.

| Tier | Duration | Internal Charge |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tier 1 — Low** | 5 minutes | 600 |
| **Tier 2 — Medium** | 25 minutes | 3,000 |
| **Tier 3 — High** | 45 minutes | 5,400 |
| **Tier 4 — Very High** | 65 minutes | 7,800 |
| **Tier 5 — Ultra** | 85 minutes | 10,200 |

*   🟢 **Durability bar** shows current charge level.
*   💬 **Tooltip** shows charge percentage.
*   🔄 **Easy Install:** Can be installed while wearing the helmet.
*   ⚡ **Reusable:** Fully rechargeable at the Charging Station.

---

## 🔌 Charging Station

Recharge all battery tiers without wasting resources.

*   **Input:** Insert a battery with a Right-click.
*   **Visuals:** The station lights up while actively charging.
*   **Output:** Remove the battery with an empty-hand Right-click.
*   **Universal:** Works with all 5 battery tiers.

---

## 🗿 Helmet Stands

Decorative stands to display your headgear collection.

*   **Variants:** Wooden, Metal, Stone.
*   **Usage:**
    *   Right-click with head armor to place.
    *   Right-click with an empty hand to remove.
    *   Right-click with a different helmet to swap them instantly.
*   **Visuals:** Helmets render realistically on the stand.

---

## 📦 Content Summary

### **Blocks**
*   Wall Racks (Wooden, Metal)
*   Floor Racks (Wooden, Metal)
*   Helmet Stands (Wooden, Metal, Stone)
*   Charging Station

### **Items**
*   Mining Helmet
*   Battery (Tiers 1–5)

---

## 🛠 Technical Information

*   **Mod ID:** `practicaladditions`
*   **Minecraft Version:** `1.16.5`
*   **Loader:** `Forge`
*   **Optional Dependency:** [Curios API](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/curios) (1.16.5-4.1.0.0)

**Practical Additions — immersive utility blocks and reusable lighting for survival gameplay.**
